description: Wardrobe v2 (locked Sep 27 2026): dual-unit wardrobe. 50 named ensembles (10 per collection), each a set of ritual-tagged components with modiste-voiced lore, colorway matrix, and Atelier Album completion data. Rarity: Atelier / Couture / Impériale / Légende (was Common / Fine / Rare / Ultra-Rare). Every premium ensemble keeps a credible free path; time-only items (e.g. the Triumph Gown) carry no purchasable path by design.

_note.description: Design-team note; ignored by validation and importers.

atelier_album.description: Atelier Album completion data; design documentation, ignored by the Unity importer.

collections.description: Closet collections; ensembles reference these by collectionId.

documented_scoring_categories.description: Design documentation; ignored by validation and importers.

documented_system_rules.description: Design documentation; ignored by validation and importers.

acquisition.description: Free path is required; crowns_path is prose and may state that no purchasable path exists (time-only items).

components.description: Ritual-tagged garment components — the chapter-dressing (story-side) unit.

ritual_part.description: Chapter-dressing ritual part this component fills (bodice, sleeves, skirt, neckline, trim, shoes, hair, accessory).

harmony_bonus.description: Harmony bonus label (Daily Vote only — never tied to recency or spend).

portrait_moment.description: Atelier Album portrait-moment completion payoff text.

story.description: Ensemble lore, in the modiste's voice.

timeless.description: Time-only flag: earned, never purchasable, never returning (e.g. the Triumph Gown).

time_only.description: Legacy alias of timeless (both true on the Triumph Gown); accepted for compatibility, ignored when timeless is present.

groups_roadmap.description: Future outfit groups; theme roadmap only, not importable content.

merge_chain_signatures.description: Merge chains terminating in signature ensemble pieces; design documentation, ignored by the Unity importer.

rarity_tiers.description: Rarity tier map including the old Common/Fine/Rare/Ultra-Rare names; design documentation, ignored by the Unity importer.

saison_schedule.description: Saison drops with published vault policy; design documentation, ignored by the Unity importer.

schemaVersion.description: Optional; when present must be the expected version. Missing versions log a warning on import.

story_wardrobe_references.description: Story wardrobe references, not confirmed collectible ensembles; never auto-promoted.

vault_policy.description: Published Saison vault policy; design documentation, ignored by the Unity importer.

title: Outfits
